name: sheetxl
description: SheetXL for Codex: read, query, build and check .xlsx, .sxl and .csv workbooks through the SheetXL MCP server, with the sheetxl skill.

interface.shortDescription: Read, query, build and check spreadsheets
interface.longDescription: SheetXL is an Excel-grade spreadsheet built for agents and developers. Query a workbook like a database instead of pulling cells into context, and run TypeScript inside the calculation engine to build, check and fix formula models. Bundles the SheetXL MCP server and the sheetxl skill.
defaultPrompt: Open this workbook with SheetXL, describe its structure, and check it for formula errors.
